name: Quadrant
author: Bernard Visagie
description: Unified system monitor for the Quattro bar: CPU, GPU, memory, network, and an optional disk segment, with a tabbed detail panel.

barWidget.description: CPU, GPU, memory, and network readouts with a tabbed detail panel (Drives tab included; dedicated GPU only in the bar; disk fills the GPU slot when none is present)

schema.label: Bar segments
schema.description: Which metric segments appear in the bar slot. Each panel tab has a Show in bar checkbox that updates this list. An empty list keeps a compact system-monitor icon. The GPU segment is dedicated cards only; when none is detected the gpu token is shown as Drives unless diskFallbackWithoutGpu is false.

options.label: GPU
options.description: Dedicated card busy % (Drives stands in when there is none)

schema.label: Process rows
schema.description: How many top processes each panel tab lists.

schema.label: Bar refresh (ms)
schema.description: Cadence of the streaming sampler that feeds the bar segments and history graphs.

schema.label: Panel refresh (ms)
schema.description: Cadence of the on-demand samplers that run while the panel is open.

schema.label: Interface (auto or name)
schema.description: Interface whose rates the network segment and tab report. 'auto' picks the default route across IPv4 and IPv6 by lowest metric.

schema.label: GPU (auto or cardN)
schema.description: Which dedicated card the GPU segment and tab read. 'auto' prefers the boot display card among dedicated GPUs, else card0. Integrated cards are shown on the CPU tab instead.

schema.label: Integrated GPU (auto, none, or cardN)
schema.description: Which card is treated as integrated graphics on the CPU tab. 'auto' uses positive evidence (Intel at 00:02.x, known AMD APU names). 'none' treats every card as dedicated. A cardN value forces that card to be integrated.

schema.label: Show Drives in the bar when no dedicated GPU
schema.description: When true, the configured gpu bar token is displayed as Drives if no dedicated GPU is detected. Unchecking Show in bar on the Drives tab sets this to false. Does not rewrite the segments list.

schema.label: Disk (auto or name)
schema.description: Which whole block device the disk segment and Drives tab follow. 'auto' prefers the disk backing /, else the largest.

schema.label: Bar palette
schema.description: theme paints values at 90% or more with the theme urgent color; heat ramps every value from muted through accent to urgent; vivid keeps fixed per-resource hues.

schema.label: Bar labels
schema.description: glyph uses Nerd Font icons; letter falls back to C/G/M/D/N; none shows only the value.

schema.label: Network rate unit
schema.description: bytes shows B/s, KiB/s...; bits shows b/s, Kb/s... (network only).
